[[Temple Guard Bai]] guards the entrance to Tahnnakai Temple.

==Location==
*[[Kaineng City]]
**{{NPC location|Shenzun Tunnels}} (just outside [[Tahnnakai Temple (outpost)|Tahnnakai Temple]])

==Quests==
'''Quests involved in:'''
*Kaineng City
**[[To Tahnnakai Temple]]

==Dialogue==
Before [[To Tahnnakai Temple]] quest:
:''"I cannot let you in here. However, I can tell you that [[Adept Kai]] wishes to speak with <character name> in [[Senji's Corner]]. Was there anything else you wanted to talk about?"''

During To Tahnnakai Temple without [[Mhenlo]]:
:''"You cannot enter Tahnnakai Temple! Only [[Emperor Kisu|the emperor]] and those of noble blood can enter this holy place. Since you obviously are not royalty, I suggest you find someone who is. Otherwise, you can give up any ideas you have of entering the temple."''

During To Tahnnakai Temple with Mhenlo:
:''"I cannot let you into the temple unless you are with someone of royal blood. Right now, you certainly are not. I see Brother Mhenlo there...I know he visited this temple many times in the past. Perhaps <character name> should ask him how to go about befriending the right people, if you know what I mean."''

After To Tahnnakai Temple:
:''"Please continue on through."''
